findings: The market kit gives market buyers only name, URL and reviews before shop selection; card descriptions are not in that list. Other buyers may separately fetch cards.
No customer_id was observed in the inspected loyalty tasks; repeat tiers cannot identify returning anonymous buyers.
Public reviews at the same reserve price differ with buyer budget (lamp100:3 or5; chair180:3 or5). The shop cannot guarantee high ratings.
A final offer below reserve does not establish the buyer maximum budget.
Reported 4/10 deals per visit is a small sample, not a stable conversion estimate.
recommended_next_experiment: Make the item response state a single final payable amount, already discounted, with no additional discount implied; keep ask metadata.
For sales volume, consider the same reserve-level price for repeat buyers as well; this changes the previously selected loyalty policy and has not been applied.
Prioritize stable hosting and a stable public URL; current free SSH tunnel has repeatedly reconnected. No purchase or new deployment was made.
Observe a fixed next-20-visit window and count completed deals, below-reserve last offers, protocol failures and new reviews separately.
